# FLX-3619: a consumer query or view holds more than one statement

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A query or a view is exactly one statement. A text that holds two, such as a SELECT followed by a DROP, is refused whole, so that no later statement is ever read as part of the first. Split the text into separate queries.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3619
```
